title: Math — Perimeter & area (squares, rectangles, circles, triangles & quadrilaterals)
subject: math

questions.prompt: A square has side length 7 cm. What is its perimeter?
A square has side length 6 cm. What is its area?
A rectangle is 5 m long and 11 m wide. What is its perimeter?
A rectangle has length 8 cm and width 3.5 cm. What is its area?
A circle has radius 15 cm. Use π ≈ 3.14. What is the circumference?
A circle has diameter 10 cm. Use π ≈ 3.14. What is the area of the circle?
A triangle has base 14 cm and height 9 cm. What is its area?
A parallelogram has base 7 cm. The perpendicular height to that base is 6 cm. What is its area?
A trapezoid has parallel sides of length 4 cm and 10 cm. The perpendicular distance (height) between them is 5 cm. What is its area?
A rhombus has diagonals of length 8 cm and 6 cm. What is its area? (Use: area = ½ × d₁ × d₂)
A *regular polygon* has all sides equal and all interior angles equal. Which quadrilateral is always regular?
Two rectangles can have the same perimeter but different areas. Rectangle A is 2 cm × 10 cm. Rectangle B has the same 24 cm perimeter but is 5 cm × 7 cm. Which rectangle has the greater area?
